premises.text: The world relies heavily on fossil fuels, and the transition to green energy is slow.
premises.evidence_span: 84% of the world is powered by fossil fuels. That's only a 2% decrease in the past 20 years.

premises.text: Current battery technology is toxic and material-intensive, making recycling insufficient.
premises.evidence_span: the metals that we use in our current battery tech are not only toxic, but very scarce as well.

premises.text: Flint's paper batteries are a safer and more sustainable alternative to traditional batteries.
premises.evidence_span: Flint's paper batteries come in. Now, our batteries are rechargeable, and they work very similar to lithium batteries.

premises.text: The materials used in paper batteries are abundant and cost-effective.
premises.evidence_span: the cost of making our paper batteries isn't two times or three times cheaper, but it's ten times cheaper.

premises.text: Paper batteries can be designed to be flexible and safe during operation.
premises.evidence_span: our batteries can be bent while operational without affecting its performance or causing any kind of safety hazard.

premises.text: Flint's batteries can be produced using existing manufacturing processes.
premises.evidence_span: we didn't have to reinvent the wheel to create this. We used existing manufacturing processes and equipment.

premises.text: Flint's paper batteries can be applied in various sectors, including energy storage and consumer tech.
premises.evidence_span: you can start to see paper batteries in energy storage systems.

value.text: Flint's paper batteries provide a greener, safer, and more cost-effective solution for energy storage.
value.evidence_span: a greener future demands greener batteries.

notes: Revenue projections and partnerships are excluded as traction.
